$description:
DERIVED alpha steps. Each entry names a base colour token and the opacity percentages that components need from it. The emitter computes `<base>-<step>` by taking the BASE TOKEN'S OWN CHANNELS and applying the alpha — so a derived step can never drift from its base. Never hand-author a `-NN` token as its own colour; add the step here instead.

Why these exist at all: Tailwind expresses this natively in code (`bg-primary/90`), so the CODE needs no extra variable. FIGMA has no such syntax — a variable is either opaque or it isn't. These are emitted to Figma so a designer can reach the same value the code reaches, from the same source. See docs/process/TOKEN-PIPELINE.md.

Each step below is justified by a real class in src/ui/*.tsx — nothing speculative.
